value.rationale: The arrival age of the largest key is a natural feature of randomized BST construction, and the global total internal path length measures comparison cost. A simultaneously coupled all-slot stochastic order, exact neighboring-gap tails, and exact final-two-slot equality provide a structural classification unavailable from marginal moments alone. These results characterize a nontrivial dependence between a marked arrival and global tree geometry.
